issues.display_title: Issue #1819: [Audit] PayPal REST API subscriptions & invoices inconsistencies
issues.main_description_html:
Goal: Ensure exact parity between PayPal REST API and local DB (cc_purchase, user status). Detect billing anomalies and backfill missing historical records.

Audit Summary (Executed 2026-09-03)

  • New Cronjob Verification: Running properly with 0 missing invoices for current billing periods (100% of August & September 2026 recurring charges recorded in cc_purchase).
  • Zombie Local: 0 cases (No canceled/suspended PayPal profiles active in local DB).
  • Zombie PayPal: 0 cases (All 32 active PayPal subscriptions are fully in sync with local DB user states).
  • Test User Isolation: Filtered 3 test/sandbox accounts (19039, 23926, 42828) via HelperClass::getStripeTestUserIds().
  • Missing Historical Invoices Identified: 115 completed transactions across 24 users missing in cc_purchase (Sep 2025 – Jul 2026) due to the legacy cronjob. Detail list saved in docs/investigations/2026-09-03-paypal-rest-subscription-audit.json.

Historical Gap Breakdown (Sep 2025 – Jul 2026)

  • 2025-09 to 2026-02: ~5 missing / month
  • 2026-03: 10 missing
  • 2026-04: 13 missing
  • 2026-05: 18 missing
  • 2026-06: 23 missing
  • 2026-07: 21 missing

Next Action Items

  • One-Time Backfill: Create and execute a dry-runnable backfill command to insert the 115 missing cc_purchase rows and generate invoices for historical transactions.
  • Parity Verification: Re-verify DB records against PayPal REST API after backfill to ensure 100% parity across all historical periods.
